tables.name: Garrison Equipment
tables.description: Whether the garrison has what it needs to function effectively.

results.name: Poor
results.description: Guards are equipped with substandard kit and lack a dedicated training area.

results.name: Standard
results.description: Guards are equipped with standard kit, and have a dedicated training area with basic practice equipment (simple targets, poles for combat dummies, etc.).

results.name: Decent
results.description: Guards are equipped with standard kit, and have a dedicated training area and equipment for use. They demonstrate refined practice techniques, such as specific drills, for a variety of situations.

results.name: Good
results.description: Guards are equipped with above-standard kit, and have a dedicated training area and equipment for use. They utilize highly refined practice techniques, such as specific drills, for a variety of situations.

results.name: Exemplary
results.description: Guards are equipped with the best kit available, and have a dedicated training area, complete with the best of any and all training equipment and practices that would be required.
